name: checkpoint
description: Context checkpoints for Even Keel sessions: once the context passes 150k tokens (and every 50k after, every 25k past 250k), the session is asked to write a handoff note and end its turn with `CHECKPOINT: <path>`, so that Even Keel continues the task in a fresh session instead of re-reading the whole context on every turn. A session that writes the note but forgets the line is sent back to add it. Thresholds: CHECKPOINT_FIRST_TOKENS, CHECKPOINT_STEP_TOKENS, CHECKPOINT_LATE_TOKENS and CHECKPOINT_LATE_STEP_TOKENS.
